idx_staff_sessions_reauth_ok.name: idx_staff_sessions_reauth_ok

key_tags_exactly_one_target_chk.name: key_tags_exactly_one_target_chk
key_tags_exactly_one_target_chk.value:
(
CASE
    WHEN (room_id IS NULL) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END +
CASE
    WHEN (locker_id IS NULL) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END) = 1

lane_sessions_waitlist_requested_resourc.name: lane_sessions_waitlist_requested_resource_type_check
lane_sessions_waitlist_requested_resourc.value: (waitlist_requested_resource_type IS NULL) OR ((waitlist_requested_resource_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['room'::character varying, 'locker'::character varying])::text[]))

lane_sessions_flow_last_actor_check.name: lane_sessions_flow_last_actor_check
lane_sessions_flow_last_actor_check.value: (flow_last_actor IS NULL) OR ((flow_last_actor)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['CUSTOMER'::character varying, 'EMPLOYEE'::character varying, 'SYSTEM'::character varying])::text[]))
